question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping's entrenched control over the Chinese Communist Party's central institutions, including the Politburo Standing Committee and security apparatus, underpins the 95.5% trader consensus that he will remain in power through 2026. With the 21st National Congress scheduled for late 2027, recent developments such as cadre promotions favoring Xi-aligned officials, active diplomatic engagements, and the absence of reported internal challenges or health concerns reinforce expectations of continuity into a fourth term. While skin-in-the-game pricing assigns only marginal odds to removal, low-probability scenarios including sudden medical issues, elite factional shifts, or unforeseen crises could still prompt market movement before year-end.

Traders’ consensus reflects this uncertainty, with outcomes hinging on midterm results and any late declarations.
